S.FORM: alang Kolado't ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Nakahama go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 106 buwan, 266 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 92% kyan ku 244 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 8% kyan ku 22 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 87%, Kebalan 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 4%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kolado't hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Kolado't hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Kolado't hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kolado't hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kolado't hya' ga Polo't. tay mkyahu' na Kolado't hya' ga Nadan. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan alang Kolado't ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kola*oʔt ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu nakaħama ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** keβalan * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa poloʔt taj mkjaħuʔ na kola*oʔt ħjaʔ ɣa na*an reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan alaŋ kola*oʔt ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
